claim_text: The end-to-end HAI P1 INNER architecture has been implemented.
allowed_wording: The pinned HAI P1 INNER architecture and its frozen execution paths were implemented.
forbidden_wording: The thesis method is fully validated or generalized.
validation_needed: Expanded independent evaluation remains required for performance and generalization claims.

claim_text: Normal data can be processed into executable verified relational rules within the implemented pipeline.
allowed_wording: The implemented pipeline transformed confirmed normal-data relation evidence into frozen executable rules under deterministic authority controls.
forbidden_wording: The pipeline discovered physically true or causal rules.
validation_needed: Broader datasets and rule families require separate preregistration and evaluation.

claim_text: The deterministic verifier checks structural evidence-bound parameter split and execution-contract validity.
allowed_wording: VerifierV1 deterministically checks its canonical contract; VALIDATION V2 executable eligibility is separately governed by Formal V4 validity replay numeric binding portfolio-freeze runtime-authorization and custody controls.
forbidden_wording: VerifierV1 directly authorizes V4 runtime or scientifically proves the rule or a causal relation.
validation_needed: Scientific utility remains a separate evaluation question; Formal V4 does not establish causal or physical truth.

claim_text: Fixed-rule runtime execution is LLM-free and deterministic given frozen rule reference and input authorities.
allowed_wording: Given frozen Formal V4 descriptor validity numeric-reference portfolio runtime-authorization and input authorities the fixed-rule VALIDATION V2 runtime evaluates without an LLM and produces deterministic traces.
forbidden_wording: All current or future research runtime modes are LLM-free or Canonical VerifierV1 directly authorizes the V4 runtime.
validation_needed: Fresh-machine scientific reproduction remains custody-blocked and is needed for portability evidence.

claim_text: GDN provides unique useful relations beyond META and STAT.
allowed_wording: The frozen GDN arm contributed set-unique candidates; their unique scientific usefulness remains unvalidated.
forbidden_wording: GDN uniquely improves detection finds causal relations or is superior to META and STAT.
validation_needed: Preregistered stability isolated confirmation yield and masking analyses are required.

claim_text: Agentic verifier feedback improves rule quality.
allowed_wording: The current pilot did not establish a feedback advantage and the feedback mechanism was not empirically exercised.
forbidden_wording: Agentic feedback improved rule quality or optimized performance.
validation_needed: An independent budget-matched repairable cohort must exercise and measure feedback recoveries.

claim_text: Verified Rule-only showed different attack-event responses from D0 in the current INNER pilot.
allowed_wording: In the current 14-event INNER pilot D1 responded to three D0-missed events and D0 responded to one D1-missed event.
forbidden_wording: Rule-only generally complements or outperforms the detector.
validation_needed: Independent expanded-event and held-out evaluation are required.

allowed_wording: Rule-only showed high event response and high normal false-alarm burden in the INNER pilot; practical utility remains unvalidated.
forbidden_wording: Rule-only is operationally deployable or practically useful as is.
validation_needed: A preregistered operational evaluation needs acceptable false-alarm criteria expanded events and held-out evidence.

claim_text: Detector plus Rule improves detection performance.
allowed_wording: The two frozen D2 policies did not improve D0 attack-event recall in the current INNER pilot.
forbidden_wording: Detector-plus-Rule improves detection or fusion can never work.
validation_needed: Any broader claim requires a new preregistered policy and independent data.

allowed_wording: Held-out generalization remains unconfirmed because no OUTER scientific result is available.
forbidden_wording: The method generalizes to held-out attacks or OUTER performance failed.
validation_needed: A newly authorized preregistered held-out study with valid custody is required.

claim_text: The explanation faithfully reproduces frozen rule and runtime-trace information.
allowed_wording: The implemented renderer is deterministically bound to frozen rule and trace information; comprehensive faithfulness remains to be evaluated.
forbidden_wording: All explanations are scientifically faithful complete or useful to humans.
validation_needed: Execute a preregistered automated faithfulness audit across relevant outcomes and error classes.

claim_text: The explanation improves human understanding or operations.
allowed_wording: A trace-grounded explanation interface is implemented; human usefulness has not been evaluated.
forbidden_wording: The explanations improve understanding diagnosis trust or operations.
validation_needed: A separate human or expert evaluation is required if this becomes thesis-essential.

claim_text: The discovered relations are causal or root-cause relationships.
allowed_wording: The system records bounded temporal relation evidence and trace-grounded violations without causal attribution.
forbidden_wording: The graph identifies causes causal relations or root causes.
validation_needed: Causal wording requires a separate causal design and evidence authority not present here.
